name: Pop Menu
description: A tiny round button that opens on click and turns into a full menu; the background indicator springs between options and "Exit" closes the menu.
interactionNotes: Press the round button: the frame springs open, the items arrive in a stagger and the spring indicator moves to the active option. Hovering any option makes the indicator follow it. The danger option ("Exit") is red and selecting it closes the menu. Escape or an outside click also closes it; Enter and Space both open it and select an option.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu options; each item has `{ id, label, icon, danger }`, and a divider is just `{ id, divider: true }`. Omit it? The component's own Persian menu is used.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. If you do not pass it, the component keeps the state itself.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called on every open or close.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled active option — determines where the spring indicator sits.

props.name: defaultActiveId
props.description: The first active option in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Returns the id of any selected option.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the open menu; the closed button is always a 40-pixel square.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Stiffness of the frame's opening spring — the same default shape.

props.name: damping
props.description: Damping of the opening spring; lower means more oscillation.

props.name: indicatorStiffness
props.description: Stiffness of the indicator's spring — the speed of the jump between options.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the indicator bar beside the active option; if omitted, the theme ink remains. For a brand color, pass e.g. `var(--color-brand)`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims it and makes it unresponsive to pointer and keyboard.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the toggle button — it carries this label in both states.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the 40-pixel container — e.g. `absolute` to anchor it to a corner of a frame.

tips: Icons can be any node; a simple svg with a 24 viewBox is enough — the component itself has no icon dependency.
`danger` does not just turn red; selecting it also closes the menu — suitable for any one-way action such as exit and delete.
Anchor the button with `className="absolute ..."` and the menu opens from that same point like a popover; the site preview does exactly this.
